summary: Vale S.A. filed a 6-K reporting that shareholder Previ requested an EGM to remove board member Daniel Andr Stieler and elect José Maurício Pereira Coelho as his replacement, with Previ supporting Manuel Lino Silva de Sousa Oliveira for Chairman. The board is assessing the call of the EGM per Brazilian corporate law and Vale's bylaws. This is a forced board shake-up by an activist shareholder. Watch for the EGM outcome and whether the dissident slate succeeds, which could shift strategic direction at the mining giant.
